welcome.title: Cook to the season.
welcome.body: One minute now, and every suggestion fits the kitchen you actually cook in.
welcome.cuisineBody: Mediterranean, Levantine, Andean garden or Nordic smoke. Where your palate lives.
welcome.dietBody: Plant preferences, gluten-free staples, fresh spice and what you cook for pleasure.
welcome.rhythmBody: Twenty-minute weeknights, or slow weekend braises in clay.

cuisines.title: Pick your favourite kitchens.

rhythm.title: How do you cook?
rhythm.body: We match technique and prep time to the habits you actually keep.

done.footnote: You can change any of this later in Settings.
